_notes: pgg_cost.py calibration overlay (task #71, EMIR 2 M2a). Generated by pgg_cost_calibrate.py --m1-run-dir from the M1 plumbing measurement (tesisat ölçümü, not analysis data); aggregates only, no account id, no text, raw_calls.jsonl not read. pgg_cost loads the base file and replaces its entries of the models below with these. kinds: what pgg_cost uses (all rounds, prompt in abstract_v2 prompt units); measured: the M1 calls themselves (round 1 / X = 10, abstract_v3). Every number of a kind is (tahmin) for a future run; see assumptions.
p95_method: linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy default)

price_usd_per_m.source: calibration: billed usage.cost_details (prompt / completions) / tokens of the 18 Mistral calls of tesisat_olcum_20261007 (M1)

later_rounds.text: completion tokens of rounds 2-10 and of the other isolated values (tahmin): M1 value x the LARGEST all / measured-subset ratio of the pilot v2 reasoning models in the mini-pilot (deepseek, gpt): contribute_N all rounds / round 1, isolated all values / X = 10; mean and p95 each

assumptions: prompt tokens (tahmin): Mistral tokens per prompt character measured in M1 (contribute_N 0.2658, isolated 0.2657; round 1 and X = 10, no history) x mean characters of the abstract_v2 prompt over rounds 1-10 (synthetic history, pgg_game.mean_prompt_chars, M1's cards); pgg_game scales it to the frame
prompt p95 (tahmin): mean x the largest pilot v2 p95 / mean of the same kind (deepseek, gpt)

completion tokens of rounds 2-10 and of the other isolated values (tahmin): M1 value x the LARGEST all / measured-subset ratio of the pilot v2 reasoning models in the mini-pilot (deepseek, gpt): contribute_N all rounds / round 1, isolated all values / X = 10; mean and p95 each
comprehension (tahmin): as for every model, contribute_N tokens, prompt scaled to its own length (pgg_cost.EXTRAPOLATED_KINDS)
cost from completion_tokens (billed), not reasoning_tokens: in 11 of 18 M1 responses reasoning_tokens > completion_tokens
paid-invalid share (tahmin) = pooled pilot v2 ratio of the measured models (cost 0.181866, calls 0.119136); M1 had 0 invalid of 18, too few to estimate it
M1 is a plumbing measurement in one frame (abstract_v3), not analysis data
